description: A selected set of strings that can't convert to the unified list of numbers is an error
notes: The spec unifies a set of strings and a list of numbers to a list of strings (set and list give list, string and number give string), so this should give ["x"]. hashicorp/hcl picks the list of numbers because an unsafe conversion to it from the set of strings exists (unify in cty/convert/unify.go), and converting "x" to a number then fails, here for the true result (native/types/unify-list-and-set-unifies-element-types has it in the false result).
reference_error: The true result value has the wrong type
